-- function-wrapped column: harder to prune
SELECT COUNT(*) AS feb_joiners
FROM   students
WHERE  YEAR(joined) = 2026 AND MONTH(joined) = 2;

-- plain range on the column: prunes on min/max
SELECT COUNT(*) AS feb_joiners
FROM   students
WHERE  joined >= '2026-02-01' AND joined < '2026-03-01';
